title: Fans Say Beloved Country Star Is a 'Perfect Fit' for 'Lifting Lives' ACM Honor - NewsBreak
text: Fans say that the Academy of Country Music could not have picked a better honoree for this year's Lifting Lives Award than Jelly Roll . The "humble" musician was chosen to receive the honor during this year's Academy of Country Music Honors ceremony later this summer. According to the academy, the rapper-turned-country star was voted for the award by a special board of directors and was chosen because he "is devoted to improving lives through the power of music, has a generosity of spirit, and is committed to serving others." "Jelly Roll embodies the @acmliftinglives mission of improving lives through the power of music with immense contributions in his philanthropic work and a commitment to using his platform for positive change," the organization explained in a social media announcement on July 9. "He donated $1 from every ticket sold on his Backroad Baptism Tour, raising over $600,000 for at-risk youth, plus has visited over 10 juvenile facilities, 4 rehabilitation centers, and numerous homeless shelters to use his growing platform as a beacon of hope and resilience. On the national level, he testified before Congress to advocate for the need for mental health treatment and readily available resources to combat the fentanyl crisis." Fans felt that the "Son of a Sinner" singer was the "perfect fit for this award," praising the honor in the comments. "Love this!!!" one gushed, while another declared it was "Well deserved❤️❤️❤️." "@jellyroll615 love you, your music and all you do. Ty," they added. "SUCH A 💎," another praised. This year's ACM Honors ceremony is scheduled for Aug. 20.
